changelog:
Initial release: Search and fetch UK jobs from Gumtree with bb-browser.

- Enables searching for full-time, part-time, temporary, and casual job ads on Gumtree UK.
- Supports structured queries using user-supplied role, location, and contract type, with sector-specific slugs.
- Returns both search results (JSON) and detailed listings (full advert text, Markdown image preview).
- Jobs-only: excludes pets, property sales, motors, and collectibles.
- Requires bb-browser and setup of bb-sites/gumtree scripts for operation.
